deck_name: Ma Diao (馬吊) — Chinese Money-Suited Cards (the Deep Root)

suit-cash.name: 文錢 · Cash (Coins)
suit-cash.Scene: Cards of the 文錢 (wénqián) cash suit, representing individual copper coins with a square hole at the centre. Pip cards show the coin symbol — a round disc with square opening — in numerical arrangements. No surviving image in this grammar.

suit-strings.name: 索子 · Strings of Cash
suit-strings.Scene: Cards of the 索子 (suǒzǐ) strings-of-cash suit, representing multiple coins strung together on a cord. Pip cards show string or bundle symbols. No surviving image in this grammar.

suit-myriads.name: 萬貫 · Myriads
suit-myriads.Scene: Cards of the 萬貫 (wànguàn) myriads suit, representing ten thousand strings of cash — an abstract denomination of extraordinary wealth. No surviving image in this grammar.

suit-tens.name: 十萬 · Tens of Myriads
suit-tens.Scene: Cards of the 十萬 (shíwàn) tens-of-myriads suit, representing hundreds of thousands of cash. No surviving image in this grammar.

axis-money-suits.name: The Four Money Suits
axis-money-suits.Scene: The four suits of the Ma Diao pack together encode a monetary ladder: cash (individual coins), strings (coin bundles), myriads (ten thousand strings), and tens of myriads. No composite image survives; this is a conceptual grouping.

card-102351.name: Ma Diao card — Skokloster 102351
card-102351.Scene: A woodblock-printed card on thick paper. The upper third contains a panel with bold Chinese characters. The centre shows a stylised radiating sun-like or face-like form rendered in black ink, surrounded by radiating lines. The lower third has angular geometric patterns — repeated arrowhead and diagonal shapes — in a grid.

card-102352.name: Ma Diao card — Skokloster 102352
card-102352.Scene: A woodblock card with a Chinese character panel at the upper left (including the character 五 — five). The centre shows a crescent or curved shape with hatched internal geometry and angular surrounding decoration. The lower portion has dotted and triangular border patterns.

card-102353.name: Ma Diao card — Skokloster 102353
card-102353.Scene: A woodblock-printed card showing a human figure — a court official or deity — rendered in frontal bust view. The face is detailed with clear features; the head bears a distinctive cap or hat. The lower body is shown in linear abstract style, surrounded by geometric hatching.

card-102354.name: Ma Diao card — Skokloster 102354
card-102354.Scene: A woodblock card with a Chinese character panel at top (including 石有 or similar). Below, a court figure is shown in a three-quarter or frontal view, wearing a distinctive official hat. Chinese characters appear on the body of the figure, identifying them by name or title.

card-102355.name: Ma Diao card — Skokloster 102355
card-102355.Scene: A woodblock pip card with three geometric motifs arranged vertically — each a nested diamond or square set within concentric lines, suggesting a stylised coin or token symbol. The card has no character panel; it is a pure pip.

card-102356.name: Ma Diao card — Skokloster 102356
card-102356.Scene: A woodblock pip card showing six round coin symbols arranged in a 2×3 grid. Each coin shows concentric circles with a square or geometric centre — the standard Chinese cash coin motif. The coins are clearly differentiated by their interior patterns.

card-102357.name: Ma Diao card — Skokloster 102357
card-102357.Scene: An abstract woodblock card with two distinct zones: the upper half carries a dense angular star or cross pattern of intersecting diagonal lines; the lower half shows concentric arc or rainbow-shaped lines. There is no figure or character panel.

card-102358.name: Ma Diao card — Skokloster 102358
card-102358.Scene: A woodblock pip card showing six oval or rounded coin symbols arranged in a 2×3 grid. The coins are rendered in slightly rounder, more fluid form than the square-centred cash coins on card 102356, suggesting a different suit or denomination.

card-102359.name: Ma Diao card — Skokloster 102359
card-102359.Scene: A woodblock card showing a single large abstract composition: the upper half features a concentric square or rectangular pattern (nested squares converging to a centre), while the lower half is filled with cross-hatch geometric lines. The design fills the entire card field.

card-102360.name: Ma Diao card — Skokloster 102360
card-102360.Scene: A woodblock card showing a stylised animal or creature figure rendered in bold linear strokes. The form suggests a dragon or mythological beast — sinuous body, legs visible at bottom, energetic movement conveyed through diagonal brushwork.

card-102361.name: Ma Diao card — Skokloster 102361
card-102361.Scene: A damaged card — the upper-left corner is torn away. Two rounded coin symbols are visible at the top register and a third in the centre, above horizontal stripe patterns in the lower half. The design is consistent with a low-value pip card.

card-sheet-13617.name: Ma Diao cards (sheet) — Skokloster 13617
card-sheet-13617.Scene: A museum photograph showing all eleven surviving Skokloster Ma Diao cards spread on a surface, accompanied by a folded paper wrapper inscribed in Swedish 'Kinesiska kort' (Chinese cards). The variety of designs is visible: coin-pip grids, court figures with character labels, geometric abstracts, and decorative cards in one ensemble.

skokloster-set.name: The Skokloster Surviving Set
skokloster-set.Scene: The complete Skokloster Ma Diao set: eleven individual cards (accession numbers 102351–102361) plus a separate sheet (13617), all held at Skokloster Castle, Sweden. The cards are woodblock-printed on heavy paper, showing a mix of pip cards (coin grids, geometric abstracts) and court cards (figural representations of officials or deities).
